    A pointwise description of the subcategory B_E #

    For a finite set E ⊆ I, call a representation M of I_* E-good if it is pointwise finite-dimensional, its structure maps between points of I are surjective, a structure map M(s ≤ t) with s, t ∈ I is injective when no e ∈ E satisfies s ≤ e < t, and M vanishes beyond E. The intervals Y, A e, P e (e ∈ E) are good, and good representations are closed under extensions (Lemma 2.1, Step 2) and retracts. In Intervals/Decomposition.lean every good representation is shown to be a finite direct sum of such intervals.
